title: Molecular docking and pharmacophore models to probe binding hypothesis of inhibitors of hypoxia inducible factor-1.
authors: Rehman, Zaira; Jabeen, Ishrat; Fahim, Ammad; Bhatti, Attya; John, Peter
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和药效团模型筛选HIF-1抑制剂，涉及TF二聚化而非直接TF-DNA互作，方法可迁移但对象偏离核心。
abstract: Hypoxia inducible factor-1 is a heterodimeric transcription factor that regulates cellular responses to hypoxia and is involved in tumor progression and resistance to chemotherapy. Dimerization between HIF-1alpha and beta subunits has been recognized crucial for DNA binding and transcriptional activity of HIF-1. Therefore, inhibitors of alpha and beta dimerization subunits of HIF-1 may potentially evade HIF-1-mediated chemotherapy resistance. In the current study, ligand-based pharmacophore model was developed to determine 3 D binding features of HIF-1 inhibitors. The selected pharmacophore model comprises of one hydrogen bond donor, one hydrogen bond acceptor and one hydrophobic feature. The selected model was used for virtual screening of publically available data base by ChemBridge Corporation. Overall, six potential hits against HIF-1alpha and beta dimerization have been identified. These include, Hit 1 (4-(4-chlorophenyl)-2,6-dimethyl-3,5-pyridinedicarboxylic acid), 3 (2-[2-(2-hydroxybenzoyl)carbonohydrazonoyl]benzoic acid) and 5 (3-(4-methoxyphenyl)-2,4-quinolinedicarboxylic acid) nicotonic acid derivatives, Hit 2 (3-[(1-adamantylamino)sulfonyl]benzoic acid), 4 (5-[(2-fluorophenyl)amino]sulfonyl-2-methylbenzoic acid), and 6 (4-([2-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]sulfonylamino)benzoic acid) sulfonamide derivatives. Additionally, adamantyl moiety of compound 2 shows interactions with the experimentally known hydrophobic amino acid residues (V336, C334, E245) of HIF-1alpha and beta dimerization site. The identified hits showed lower to higher microM biological activity (IC(50)) values and thus, after further structure optimization may serve as potential inhibitor of HIF-1 dimerization in cancer chemotherapy.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 缺氧诱导因子-1是一种异二聚体转录因子，调控细胞对缺氧的反应，并参与肿瘤进展和化疗耐药。HIF-1α与β亚基之间的二聚化已被认为对HIF-1的DNA结合和转录活性至关重要。因此，抑制HIF-1α和β二聚化亚基的抑制剂可能潜在地规避HIF-1介导的化疗耐药。在本研究中，开发了基于配体的药效团模型，以确定HIF-1抑制剂的三维结合特征。所选药效团模型包含一个氢键供体、一个氢键受体和一个疏水特征。该模型被用于对ChemBridge公司公开数据库进行虚拟筛选。总体而言，已鉴定出六个针对HIF-1α和β二聚化的潜在命中化合物。这些包括：命中1（4-(4-氯苯基)-2,6-二甲基-3,5-吡啶二甲酸）、3（2-[2-(2-羟基苯甲酰基)碳酰肼基]苯甲酸）和5（3-(4-甲氧基苯基)-2,4-喹啉二甲酸）烟酸衍生物，命中2（3-[(1-金刚烷基氨基)磺酰基]苯甲酸）、4（5-[(2-氟苯基)氨基]磺酰基-2-甲基苯甲酸）和6（4-([2-(三氟甲基)苯基]磺酰基氨基)苯甲酸）磺酰胺衍生物。此外，化合物2的金刚烷基部分与实验已知的HIF-1α和β二聚化位点疏水氨基酸残基（V336、C334、E245）表现出相互作用。所鉴定的命中化合物显示出从较低到较高的微摩尔级生物活性（IC(50)）值，因此，在进一步结构优化后，可能作为癌症化疗中HIF-1二聚化的潜在抑制剂。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
